scope: Frozen exact-fastest-lap recordings: 11 cohort replays across 9 GP/year cases; not a full-season ground-truth validation
limitations: Coverage improvement is not independent proof of physical accuracy.
Different turning/straight boundaries change the metric definition; old/new totals are not like-for-like hardware measurements.
Public telemetry is sparse; three decimals are formatting.
Raw DRS codes do not identify 2026 active aero, battery state or brake pressure.
Fuel and tyre age cannot be independently identified inside one stint.
Extra diagnostics increase cold calculation cost; caching and indexed source extraction address repeated work.
